At TCI, we push the boundaries of color, durability, and performance to bring you the best powder coatings in the industry. Our cutting-edge formulations deliver lasting protection, while our commitment to customer service ensures you have the support you need—every step of the way. As the market demands improvements, color variations, and applications, we strive to implement new technologies for our customers and our environment while meeting industry standards. [...] TCI stocks hundreds of powder coating products across the nation, available in a variety of chemistries ready to ship upon order.

View Stock Products

###### INNOVATION & PERFORMANCE SINCE 1996 [...] TCI stocks hundreds of products available in a variety of colors, textures, and effects ready to ship. Our portfolio also includes 150+ Super Durable Polyester RAL colors and TCI’s TruDurance Architectural Powder Coatings, which meet AAMA & Qualicoat specifications.

TCI Powder Coating Products

### Proven Product Performance

Our coatings are tested and trusted across industries—offering durability, consistent application, and long-term performance in even the toughest environments.
